types.label: Person
types.description: A person who appears in Civgraph public data, including election candidates, MPs, and MLAs.

types.label: Political party or label
types.description: A political party, electoral label, or observed candidature label.

types.label: Elected body
types.description: A legislature, chamber, assembly, council, or other elected institution.

types.label: Political office
types.description: A role held in an elected body, such as MP or MLA.

types.label: Election
types.description: An election, referendum, recall petition, or election result bundle represented in Browse.

types.label: Election contest
types.description: A constituency, ward, DEA, local area, or other result unit within an election.

types.label: Candidature
types.description: A person's candidature or appearance in a specific election contest.

types.label: Map layer
types.description: A Civgraph map layer or map dataset exposed through Browse.

types.label: Feature group
types.description: A bounded Browse feature group for a source map layer, with feature counts and sampled/indexed feature metadata.

types.label: Geographic feature
types.description: A sampled or indexed geography feature within a source layer.

types.label: Source file or download
types.description: A downloadable or source file, including FGB, GeoJSON, PDF, CSV, KML, ZIP, image, and other file-like resources.

types.label: Provider
types.description: An organisation, publisher, public body, or data provider named in Civgraph source metadata.

types.label: Source
types.description: A source document, table, dataset, API output, PDF, HTML page, CSV, or related publication.

types.label: Register of interests record
types.description: A politician, elected body, and register-date tuple for a register of interests edition.

types.label: Register interest entry
types.description: One grouped interest entry within a register of interests record.

types.label: Map category
types.description: A catalogue category that groups map layers, e.g. Devolved Constituencies.

types.label: Year
types.description: A calendar year that groups every entity dated within it.

types.label: Month
types.description: A calendar month that groups every entity dated within it.
